channel.title: Longevity Weekly
channel.description:
The science of aging, read carefully. Every Wednesday: the week in longevity research, trials and regulation, and one mechanism of aging explained properly — what it is, what the evidence shows in animals and in people, and what it does not show. Education only; never medical advice.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.
